roadmap.title: Get started and arrange Call-Outs
roadmap.description: Finish the opening missions, try Challenges and enable a Gear MOD. Arrange the online Feat Call-Outs with a friend while easy records remain available.

roadmap.title: Finish the campaign and liberate Medici
roadmap.description: Follow the story through Insula Fonte, Dracon and Striate. Tackle the two special base challenges before liberating their targets, and help civilians when Encounters appear.

roadmap.title: Complete the base-game collections and Challenges
roadmap.description: Use the province checklists to finish collections and the garage roster. Upgrade your race equipment, reach five Gears in every Challenge and finish the Progress categories.

roadmap.title: Sky Fortress
roadmap.description: Complete the three expansion missions and intervening liberation targets. Finish the wingsuit tasks and earn five Gears in each expansion Challenge.

roadmap.title: Mech Land Assault
roadmap.description: Complete Stowaway, free the expansion island and finish its final mission. Use Force Pulse on enemy vehicles and complete both Mech arenas.

roadmap.title: Bavarium Sea Heist
roadmap.description: Get the Loochador, liberate the offshore stations and finish the heist. Complete the boat kills and the eDEN Spark tasks.

achievements.description: Get 1,000 Chaos.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 1,000 Chaos points.

steps.text: Destroy military property while liberating settlements to build your Chaos total.

achievements.description: Get 100,000 Chaos.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 100,000 Chaos points.

steps.text: Continue liberating settlements and destroying military targets until your Chaos total reaches @mechanic{100,000}.

achievements.description: Get 1,000,000 Chaos.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 1,000,000 Chaos points.

steps.text: Keep destroying military targets until your Chaos total passes @mechanic{1,000,000}. If the achievement has not appeared, earn more Chaos.

achievements.description: Destroy every Chaos Object in a Military Base without weapons, grenades, or planted explosives.
achievements.summary: Destroy every Chaos Object in one Military Base without using weapons, grenades, or planted explosives.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Vis Electra} in Baia, Insula Fonte. If already liberated, finish @loc{Son of Medici} and re-oppress the base from its map menu.
Use tethers to pull each required Chaos Object into the ground. Use melee if needed; keep weapons, grenades and planted explosives unused throughout the attempt.

achievements.displayName: This was Supposed to be a Western
achievements.description: Destroy all Chaos Objects in a Base without leaving your vehicle.
achievements.summary: Destroy every Chaos Object in one Military Base while remaining inside a vehicle.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Cima Leon: Silo} in Lacos, Insula Fonte. If already liberated, finish @loc{Son of Medici} and re-oppress the base from its map menu.
Enter the tank at the rear before damaging any required Chaos Object. Destroy the entire objective list from the tank without getting out.

achievements.description: Beat another player's score in a Challenge.
achievements.summary: Surpass another player's score in a Challenge.

steps.text: Connect to the online leaderboards and have a friend finish a Challenge with a low score.
Play that same Challenge and score higher than your friend. A Feat record does not count.

achievements.description: Earn at least 3 Gears in a Challenge.
achievements.summary: Achieve a rating of at least three Gears in one Challenge.

steps.text: Finish an unlocked Challenge with a score or time that reaches the third Gear marker.

achievements.description: Earn 5 Gears in a Challenge.
achievements.summary: Achieve a five-Gear rating in one Challenge.

steps.text: Replay a Challenge until your result reaches its fifth Gear marker.

achievements.description: Earn at least 3 Gears in one Challenge of every type.
achievements.summary: Achieve at least three Gears in one Challenge from each of the eight base-game types.

steps.text: Earn three or more Gears in a Wingsuit Course, Land Race, Scrapyard Scramble and Crash Bomb.
Do the same in a Shooting Gallery, Destruction Frenzy, Sea Race and Air Race.

achievements.description: Earn 5 Gears in every Challenge.
achievements.summary: Achieve five Gears in all 112 base-game Challenges.

guide.context: Each Challenge contributes up to five Gears. Expansion events are excluded from this base-game total.

steps.text: Liberate settlements to open the Challenge markers. Discover @loc{Grotta Contrabandero} to reveal Pirate Tour.
For Wingsuit Courses, use @mechanic{Wingsuit Air Brake} to line up rings. Disable Wingsuit Quick Close while using this approach.
In Destruction Frenzies, build the multiplier on small targets before destroying valuable objects at @mechanic{x8}. Keep the combo going after the timer expires.
In Scrapyard Scrambles, tether the attractor close to your car and switch it on. Gather a large load before delivering it; favour light-blue Bavarium.

For races, unlock the relevant @mechanic{Nitrous II} upgrade before difficult retries. Use Pescespada SS for sea races and CS7 Thunderhawk for plane races; liberating Griphon in Costa Sud unlocks the plane.
In Shooting Galleries, learn the fixed target order and aim for bullseyes. For Crash Bombs, stay above the speed threshold and bail before impact.

Check all eight event totals: Wingsuit Courses (27), Land Races (18), Scrapyard Scrambles (4), Crash Bombs (12), Shooting Galleries (5), Destruction Frenzies (25), Sea Races (9) and Air Races (12). Every event needs five Gears.

achievements.description: Unlock Rebel Drops for at least one land vehicle, one air vehicle, and one sea vehicle.
achievements.summary: Make at least one land vehicle, one aircraft, and one boat available through Rebel Drops.

steps.text: Deliver a land vehicle, an aircraft and a boat to Rebel Garages, or unlock those vehicle types by liberating military settlements.

achievements.description: Collect every vehicle available by bringing them to Mario's Rebel Garages.
achievements.summary: Deliver all 47 garage-collectible vehicles to Mario's Rebel Garages.

guide.context: Enable Vehicle Detector after earning Land Race Gears. A blue garage icon beside the vehicle name marks an uncollected model. Check Progress > Garage Blueprints for gaps. Traffic spawns vary; fast travel away and return if a vehicle is absent.

achievements.description: Find every collectible strewn across Medici.
achievements.summary: Complete all five collectible sets across Medici.

steps.text: Finish the 71-tape and 49-shrine checklists.
Recover the 54 vintage parts and pay respects at all 23 tombs.
Drive off all 30 Daredevil Jumps. Use @mechanic{Progress} to check the five sets.

achievements.description: Stand on foot at the highest point of Medici.
achievements.summary: Stand on Medici's highest summit on foot.

steps.text: Fly to the tallest snowy summit in @loc{Montana}, Insula Striate. Leave your aircraft and stand on the small stone structure at the peak.

achievements.description: Perform every Feat.
achievements.summary: Register a score in every base-game Feat.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Leaderboards > Feats} and perform each action that still has no score.
For @mechanic{Endless Runner}, find the Soap Box Car beside the broken road on the Grande Pastura/Montana border, near the vintage part. Drive the car downhill to register a distance.

achievements.description: Tether an enemy to a launched gas cannister. Adeo, amico!
achievements.summary: Launch a gas canister with an enemy tethered to it.

steps.text: At @loc{Guardia Lacos I} in Lacos, tether a soldier to a gas canister. Shoot the canister so it launches with the soldier attached.

achievements.description: Plant a Booster Explosive on an enemy soldier. Then send them flying.
achievements.summary: Send an enemy soldier flying with a Booster Explosive.

steps.text: Earn Crash Bomb Gears to unlock @mechanic{Booster Explosives}, then enable the MOD.
Attach a GE-64 charge to an enemy soldier and trigger the booster.

achievements.description: Liberate 13 settlements.
achievements.summary: Liberate a total of 13 settlements.

steps.text: Finish the liberation objectives in 13 settlements; towns, outposts and military bases all contribute.

achievements.description: Liberate a Province.
achievements.summary: Fully liberate one province.

steps.text: Clear every settlement in one province until the map shows the province as liberated.

achievements.description: Completely liberate Insula Fonte.
achievements.summary: Liberate every settlement in Insula Fonte.

steps.text: Clear every settlement objective in @loc{Insula Fonte}, including towns, outposts and military bases. Check the region on the map for any remaining occupied settlement.

achievements.description: Completely liberate Insula Dracon.
achievements.summary: Liberate every settlement in Insula Dracon.

steps.text: Clear every settlement objective in @loc{Insula Dracon}, including towns, outposts and military bases. Check the region on the map for any remaining occupied settlement.

achievements.description: Completely liberate Insula Striate.
achievements.summary: Liberate every settlement in Insula Striate.

steps.text: Clear every settlement objective in @loc{Insula Striate}, including towns, outposts and military bases. Check the region on the map for any remaining occupied settlement.

achievements.description: Unlock every weapon and vehicle available in the Rebel Drop menu.
achievements.summary: Unlock all base-game weapons and vehicles in the Rebel Drop menu.

steps.text: Finish the main story and liberate every military base.
Deliver the 47 garage vehicles and finish the tape, tomb, vintage-part and Daredevil Jump collections for their equipment rewards.
Check remaining locked entries in @mechanic{Rebel Drop} and finish the requirement shown for each one.

achievements.description: Disable the FOW in Insula Fonte.
achievements.summary: Disable the FOW protecting Insula Fonte.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Secret of Vis Electra} in the main story.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission Welcome Home.
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission Welcome Home.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Welcome Home} in the main story.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission A Terrible Reaction.
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission A Terrible Reaction.

steps.text: Finish @loc{A Terrible Reaction} in the main story.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission A Long and Dangerous Road.
achievements.summary: Finish A Long and Dangerous Road in the main campaign.

steps.text: Finish @loc{A Long and Dangerous Road} in the main story.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission The Great Escape.
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission The Great Escape.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Great Escape} in the main story.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission Missile Cowboy.
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission Missile Cowboy.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Missile Cowboy} in the main story.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission Tangled Up In Blue.
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission Tangled Up In Blue.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Tangled Up In Blue} in the main story.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission The Shatterer of Worlds.
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission The Shatterer of Worlds.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Shatterer of Worlds} in the main story.

achievements.description: 100% Just Cause 3.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion in the base game.

guide.context: The expansion areas and their Challenges do not contribute to the base-game completion requirement.

steps.text: Finish the main story and liberate all settlements across the three base-game regions.
Complete the five collectible sets and all garage deliveries.
Earn five Gears in every base-game Challenge, then check @mechanic{Progress} for any unfinished category.

achievements.description: Take sanctuary in a monastery to clear Heat Level 5.
achievements.summary: Clear Heat Level 5 by taking sanctuary with a monastery priest.

steps.text: Complete Encounters to unlock a priest at a monastery, shown in blue on the map.
Cause destruction nearby until Heat reaches @mechanic{5}. Reach the priest while still at level 5 and take sanctuary. If your Heat drops, raise it to 5 and try again.

achievements.description: Call-Out another player in a Feat.
achievements.summary: Send another player a Feat Call-Out.

steps.text: While connected online, open @mechanic{Commlink > Leaderboards > Feats}. Select a Feat with your recorded score and send a @mechanic{Call-Out} to a friend with a lower score.

achievements.description: Unlock your first Gear MOD, and then activate it.
achievements.summary: Unlock a Gear MOD and switch that MOD on.

steps.text: Earn Gears from a Challenge, then open @mechanic{Gear MODs} and enable an unlocked upgrade.

achievements.description: Unlock every Gear MOD in a single category.
achievements.summary: Unlock all Gear MODs in one upgrade category.

steps.text: Earn @mechanic{15 Gears} across the four Scrapyard Scrambles to unlock every Tether MOD.

achievements.description: Have every Gear MOD active for at least 1 minute each.
achievements.summary: Keep every base-game Gear MOD enabled for at least one minute per MOD.

steps.text: Unlock the full base-game Gear MOD list through Challenges. Switch every MOD on and leave the upgrades enabled for at least one minute.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission Son of Medici.
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission Son of Medici.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Son of Medici} in the main story.

achievements.description: Beat a score you were Called-Out on.
achievements.summary: Beat the Feat score specified in a Call-Out sent to you.

steps.text: Ask a friend to send you a @mechanic{Call-Out} on a Feat with an easy score to beat.
While connected online, exceed the called-out score in that Feat. Use the same vehicle or weapon if the Feat specifies one.

achievements.description: Complete an Encounter.
achievements.summary: Complete one random open-world Encounter.

steps.text: Help with a random open-world Encounter. Use a task outside the scripted tutorial.

achievements.description: Unlock 10 Resupply Points by completing Encounters.
achievements.summary: Open 10 Resupply Points through random Encounters.

steps.text: Travel between towns and complete civilian help Encounters, including towing and vehicle deliveries. Continue until ten rewards have opened Resupply Points.

achievements.description: Unlock 3 Heat-Clearing Priests by completing Encounters.
achievements.summary: Unlock three Heat-Clearing Priests through Encounters.

steps.text: Complete help Encounters near unavailable monasteries until three priests offer sanctuary.

achievements.displayName: Like a Fish... in the Air!
achievements.description: Use the Bavarium Wingsuit to take off from water.
achievements.summary: Take off from the water using the Bavarium Wingsuit.

steps.text: Start Sky Fortress to receive the @item{Bavarium Wingsuit}. Enter the water and hold the wingsuit deployment control while swimming.

achievements.description: Use the Barrel Roll to evade 10 incoming missiles.
achievements.summary: Evade 10 incoming missiles with Bavarium Wingsuit barrel rolls.

steps.text: Fly in the Bavarium Wingsuit near hostile Sky Fortress enemies. When an incoming missile warning appears, move sideways and use the barrel-roll control to evade it; dodge ten missiles this way.

achievements.description: Beat the last mission of the Sky Fortress Expansion and complete the story arc.
achievements.summary: Finish the Sky Fortress storyline.

steps.text: Finish the three Sky Fortress story missions. Between missions, liberate the marked fortress and mining areas to open the next objective.

achievements.description: Defeat the "Old Friend" (Boss at the end of "Taking Control").
achievements.summary: Defeat the Old Friend boss during Taking Control.

steps.text: In @loc{Taking Control}, the second Sky Fortress mission, fire rockets or explosives at the Old Friend boss's legs until it is destroyed.

achievements.description: Defeat 1 of each Drone type.
achievements.summary: Destroy at least one of each of the four Sky Fortress drone types.

guide.context: If you defeat all four types in the opening mission, the achievement waits until the mission ends.

steps.text: Destroy the excavator drones and walking tank drone introduced as targets in the first Sky Fortress mission.
Destroy a small flying drone that fires bullets and a larger flying drone that fires missiles as well. Both patrol around the fortress.

achievements.description: Earn at least 1 Gear in all Challenges of the Sky Fortress Expansion.
achievements.summary: Earn at least 1 Gear in each of the four Sky Fortress Challenges.

steps.text: Finish the three Sky Fortress wingsuit courses and its drone combat Challenge with at least one Gear per event.

achievements.description: Earn 5 Gears in all Challenges of the Sky Fortress Expansion.
achievements.summary: Earn at least 5 Gears in each of the four Sky Fortress Challenges.

steps.text: Complete all four Sky Fortress Challenges and enable the Bavarium Wingsuit upgrades unlocked by your initial Gears.
Replay the three courses and drone combat event until each shows five Gears. If missiles will not lock onto drones, disable Precision Aim and restart the game before retrying.

achievements.description: Beat the last mission of the Mech Land Assault Expansion and complete the story arc.
achievements.summary: Finish the Mech Land Assault storyline.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Stowaway}, starting in Maestrale, to reach @loc{Insula Lacrima}.
Liberate the expansion island to open its final story mission, then complete that mission.

achievements.description: Earn at least 1 Gear in all Challenges of the Mech Land Assault Expansion.
achievements.summary: Earn at least 1 Gear in both Mech Land Assault Challenges.

steps.text: Play both Mech Land Assault arena Challenges and reach at least the first Gear threshold in each.

achievements.description: Earn 5 Gears in all Challenges of the Mech Land Assault Expansion.
achievements.summary: Earn at least 5 Gears in both Mech Land Assault Challenges.

steps.text: Replay both Mech arena Challenges and finish waves quickly for the time bonus.
Use Force Grip to throw drones into enemies and containers into landed paratroopers. Use Force Pulse for extra points, then reach five Gears in each arena.

achievements.description: Hijack your first Mech.
achievements.summary: Hijack a Mech for the first time.

steps.text: During @loc{Stowaway}, disable an occupied Mech with the @item{Power Core} weapon and use the hijack prompt.

achievements.description: Liberate 3 Detention Camps.
achievements.summary: Liberate three Detention Camps on Insula Lacrima.

steps.text: After freeing the first camp during Stowaway, liberate two more Detention Camps on @loc{Insula Lacrima}.

achievements.description: Destroy 30 enemy vehicles using the Mech's Force Pulse.
achievements.summary: Destroy 30 enemy vehicles with a Mech's Force Pulse.

steps.text: Use a Mech's @mechanic{Force Pulse} to deliver the killing blow to 30 enemy vehicles. Use the Mech Challenges for more targets if needed.

achievements.description: Beat the last mission of the Bavarium Sea Heist expansion and complete the story arc.
achievements.summary: Finish the Bavarium Sea Heist storyline.

steps.text: Complete @loc{The Setup} in Cauda, Insula Dracon.
Liberate the five offshore Satellite Stations, then complete the final Bavarium Sea Heist mission.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 enemy helicopters with the Rocket Boat.
achievements.summary: Destroy five enemy helicopters with the Loochador Rocket Boat.

steps.text: Progress through Sea Heist to arm the @item{Loochador}. Lock its missiles onto enemy helicopters and destroy five.

achievements.description: Defeat 10 enemy vehicles while in the air with the Rocket Boat.
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 enemy vehicles while the Loochador Rocket Boat is airborne.

guide.context: The ten kills can be spread across separate jumps.

steps.text: Enable the sea-vehicle jump MOD and take the armed @item{Loochador} into combat.
Lock onto an enemy vehicle and fire missiles. Jump just before the target explodes so the boat is airborne when the kill registers. Accumulate ten kills this way.

achievements.description: Get the Rocket Boat, also known as "The Loochador".
achievements.summary: Obtain the Loochador Rocket Boat.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Setup}, the opening Sea Heist mission, to receive the Loochador.

achievements.description: Defeat 1 enemy helicopter using the eDEN Spark.
achievements.summary: Destroy an enemy helicopter with the eDEN Spark.

steps.text: Collect the @item{eDEN Spark} during the final Sea Heist mission. Use its lightning to destroy the enemy helicopter outside the facility.

achievements.description: Defeat 10 enemies with the same eDEN Spark strike.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies during one continuous eDEN Spark strike.

guide.context: The eDEN Spark remains available after the story, so you can use another enemy group if you miss the group outside the facility.

steps.text: After collecting the @item{eDEN Spark} in the final Sea Heist mission, target the large enemy group outside. Keep one lightning strike running and steer it through ten enemies without releasing the attack.
